title: Beta
subtitle: Who may create an account, and what people tell you. Only you see this page.

list.title: Beta list
list.hint: Only these addresses, and addresses with a pending invitation from a business, can create an account. Adding an address sends no email: tell the person yourself to sign up in the app with this same address. Taking one off stops new sign-ups and a sign-up not yet confirmed: an account already made stays.
list.added: Added to the list. Tell them to sign up with this address.
list.removeTitle: Take this address off the list?
list.removeBody: {{email}} will not be able to sign up. An account already made stays.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.hint: What people sent with "Send feedback". A copy also goes to your email.
